headline: Sangrur records 4 fire detections with Patiala forecast awaiting next day
briefing: On 2025-10-23, Sangrur recorded 4 fire detections and ranked 4 in Punjab, out of a total of 41 detections. Satellite fire detections represent a lower bound due to missed fires, cloud cover, and overpass timing [K109]. For the nearest monitored city of Patiala, the next-day PM2.5 forecast for 2025-10-24 is 75.9 ug/m3, with an 80% interval uncertainty band ranging from a p10 of 47.9 ug/m3 to a p90 of 96.7 ug/m3. Winds blew from the NW at 6.7 km/h. Upwind fire pressure toward Patiala included Outside Punjab at 64.3 percent and Sangrur at 7.3 percent share. Model reliability analysis shows test coverage of 83.1 percent for the 80% interval across 154 forecasts. Limitations include potential satellite observation gaps and changing meteorological conditions.
